input.prompt: Paint the first reference image (a layout sketch) as a real, richly detailed vintage ceramic multi-chip module, keeping EXACTLY the same layout, sizes and positions of every part. THE PACKAGE: a pale neutral grey-white sintered ceramic substrate with fine speckled grain (not a flat colour), a chamfered edge with a dark glass-frit seal seam along its bottom edge, a small pin-1 dimple top left; the ceramic is BUSY with real chip features everywhere around the parts, as dense as on the second reference: fine silver and gold thick-film traces running in parallel groups, round vias, rows of tiny SMD decoupling capacitors (tan with silver ends) and SMD resistors (black with silver ends), small square test pads and fiducials, bond fingers along the cavity; no large empty area of plain ceramic anywhere. Real gold-plated DIP pins along the top and bottom edges, evenly spaced, identical, each with its shoulder. LEFT: a flat EMPTY square brushed gold plate with a raised bevelled rim (leave its face completely blank); under it a small EMPTY rectangular recessed metal field framed by a fine engraved line (leave it blank). MIDDLE: a black textured epoxy label panel with a thin gold border. In it: a long EMPTY black strip at the top left (leave it completely blank); recessed display windows of dark smoked glass with thin gold bezels: one small window at the top right, five small square windows in a row in the middle, one wider window right of them, and one large wide window at the bottom right. Every window is EMPTY, unlit, deep black glass with a soft diagonal glare reflection across it. Small white silkscreen capital letters printed on the black epoxy, in a clean condensed sans serif, crisp and spelled exactly: "NO." just left of the small top right window; "LAST 5" just left of the row of five square windows; "W-L" just left of the wider window in the middle row; "SEASON" above "P&L" (two short lines) just left of the large bottom window. No other text anywhere. RIGHT END: a gold-plated square cavity, and in it a large square SILICON DIE filling the cavity, painted like a microscope photograph of a real EPROM die: a ring of square aluminium bond pads around its edge, a seal ring, I/O cells, and inside them dense real circuitry (memory arrays as fine grids, rows of standard cells, routing buses) in the iridescent violet, green, gold and grey thin-film colours of real silicon, with fine gold bond wires arcing from its pads to the cavity's bonding fingers. Painted comic book illustration in exactly the style, ink line, light and finish of the second reference image (the green circuit chip): crisp black ink outlines, hard cel shading, glossy highlights, fine detail; one warm golden key light from the top left; the chip alone on a pure black void with a thin green rim light along its left end and a thin red rim light along its right end. Seen perfectly straight on from above, horizontal, every edge straight and parallel to the frame. Apart from the four silkscreen labels named above, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no flags anywhere.
